#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Scenario ranges are not confidence intervals or probabilities."""
from pathlib import Path
import csv,datetime as dt
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as md
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rows=list(csv.DictReader((p/'arrival_grid.csv').open()))
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.9))
names={'concentric':'concentric','self_similar_published_cone':'self-similar cone','flattening_published_cone':'flattening cone'}
y=0;labels=[]
for event,label in [('2025-11-23T23:30:00-CME-001','865 km/s'),('2025-11-23T23:45:00-CME-001','429 km/s')]:
 for geometry in names:
  z=[r for r in rows if r['event']==event and float(r['speed_scale'])==1 and r['geometry']==geometry]
  for low,high,color,lw in [(300,600,'#a6cde2',10),(350,500,'#266b91',4)]:
   q=[dt.datetime.fromisoformat(r['arrival_utc']) for r in z if float(r['gamma_km_inverse'])>0 and low<=float(r['wind_kms'])<=high]
   ax.plot([min(q),max(q)],[y,y],color=color,lw=lw,solid_capstyle='butt',zorder=2)
  b=[dt.datetime.fromisoformat(r['arrival_utc']) for r in z if float(r['gamma_km_inverse'])==0]
  ax.scatter([b[0]],[y],color='black',marker='x',s=30,zorder=3)
  labels.append(label+'  '+names[geometry]);y+=1
  if geometry==list(names)[-1]:y+=.45
with (p.parents[1]/'observations/xmm_gtis.tsv').open() as f:
 for z in csv.DictReader(f,delimiter='\t'):
  if z['detector'].lower()=='pn':ax.axvspan(dt.datetime.fromisoformat(z['start_utc']),dt.datetime.fromisoformat(z['stop_utc']),color='#df9b23',alpha=.32,lw=0,zorder=1)
ax.set_yticks([0,1,2,3.45,4.45,5.45],labels);ax.invert_yaxis();ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(md.DayLocator(interval=1));ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(md.DateFormatter('%b %d'));ax.set_xlim(dt.datetime(2025,11,26),dt.datetime(2025,12,6));ax.grid(axis='x',alpha=.2)
ax.set_title('Independent moving-comet leading-front arrival scenarios',fontsize=12)
ax.set_xlabel('2025 UTC; gamma = 0.2–2 × 10⁻⁷ km⁻¹, catalogue speed')
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
ax.legend(handles=[Line2D([0],[0],lw=8,color='#a6cde2',label='wind 300–600 km/s'),Line2D([0],[0],lw=4,color='#266b91',label='wind 350–500 km/s'),Line2D([0],[0],color='black',marker='x',ls='',label='ballistic'),Patch(color='#df9b23',alpha=.4,label='actual PN GTIs')],loc='upper center',bbox_to_anchor=(.5,-.15),ncol=4,frameon=False,fontsize=9)
fig.text(.02,.025,'Ranges span selected drag/geometry cases; they are not likelihoods. Body duration and interactions are not included.',fontsize=9)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=.29,right=.98,top=.89,bottom=.25);fig.savefig(p/'arrival_ranges.png',dpi=170);plt.close(fig)
